Also printed in the Pro Gen 4 12MP Fisheye guide (https://illustracameras.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/UM-PG4-12MP-FE_A163818NN6_B_en-1.pdf: Stream 2 = /videoStreamId=2, Stream 3 = /videoStreamId=3) and, as "Secondary Video Stream ... rtsp://CAMERAIP/VideoStreamId=2", in the default-settings tables of the Pro 12MP Fisheye quick start guide (https://illustra.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/Web_Files/Legacy/pro-12mp-fisheye/Manuals/Illustra-Pro-12MP-Fisheye-Quick-Start-Guide-c0-lt_8200-1485-01C0_en.pdf) and the Flex 2MP PTZ quick start guide (https://illustra.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/Web_Files/Legacy/flex-2mp-ptz/Manuals/Illustra-Flex-2MP-PTZ-Quick-Start-Guide-b0_lt_8200-1486-01B0_en.pdf)

notes: Illustra (Johnson Controls / Tyco) cameras running the Illustra firmware platform address streams by number: rtsp://<ip>:554/videoStreamId=<n> (1 = Stream 1, 2 = Stream 2, 3 = Stream 3, which the web UI uses for live view). Audio is /audioStreamId=1, and video with audio is /videoStreamId=1&audioStreamId=1. This is the documented path for the Gen 4 generation (Pro Gen4, Flex Gen4, Essentials Gen4, incl. PTZ, fisheye and LPR), Pro Gen3 mini-domes, the Flex 2MP/3MP/8MP dome, bullet, box, compact and IR PTZ cameras, the Pro 2MP/3MP compact mini-dome, the Pro 12MP fisheye and the Flex 2MP 20x PTZ (the last two print it in their quick start guides as rtsp://CAMERAIP/videoStreamId=1&audioStreamID=1). Several Gen 4 guides (Pro Gen4, Flex Gen4, PTZ) and the Gen3/Flex manuals print only the Stream 1 URL plus the audio URL; the Stream 2 URL is printed in the Essentials Gen4, Gen4 fisheye and the two quick start guides. Multi-sensor models use one port per sensor: Flex Gen4 dual-sensor = sensor 1 on 554 (videoStreamId 1-3), sensor 2 on 555 (videoStreamId 4-6); Pro Gen4 20MP/32MP multisensor = sensors 1-4 on ports 554-557 (videoStreamId 1-4, 5-8, 9-12, 13-16). Lines with a DIFFERENT documented path carry it on the camera record instead: older Illustra Pro models (Pro 2MP/3MP/5MP mini-domes IPSxxD2/D3, Pro 30x PTZ IPS02P6, Pro 5MP LT fisheye ADCi825LT) use /StreamId=1 and /StreamId=2 on port 554, and the Essentials Gen 1 indoor mini-dome (Dahua-based firmware V2.420) uses /cam/realmonitor?channel=1&subtype=0|1. NOT confirmed by any official document found: Essentials Gen 3 (IES02CFBCWIYB, IES02MFBNWIYB, IES02D1OCWIYB, firmware Illustra.Esse6/Esse7) and the IP5M multisensor/panoramic models — do not assume this path for them; use ONVIF discovery. Official manuals are hosted on illustracameras.com and on the Illustra document bucket (illustra.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/Web_Files/Legacy/).
